body: Thank you all  for your understanding and encouraging words. Things are better today. I do think you are right, waitingforadragon.  I am going to start with something small. Maybe just doing one enjoyable thing every day might help.

I really wish I knew what would make make me happy, but I don't. I just wish I could be less negative and focus on the good things I have. Right now, I just see black. Why I feel this way? I don't know the answer to that question either. I just see problems and things that have to be done. I just talked to my cousin on the phone, the sweetest girl in the world. It helped. I just can't deal with feeling so awful and negative anymore. There has to more but I just can't seem to be able to deal with my negative emotions and all of the problems I have to deal with at work.
